QuestInfo.name: Livin' on the Edge
QuestInfo.1: Whew! That was a close one! Overcome your greatest struggles and show what a hero you are. Keep your #bcurrent HP at 5% or lower#k to complete this mission.

1.0: I heard you barely survived? You okay? No scratches or bruises? Sorry I put you through that! Take this gift... and no hard feelings?
